'''Vodran''' was a murky, [[Water/Legends|humid]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]], on the [[Ac'fren Spur]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Its surface featured [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], and was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]]. It was also the original planet where the garbage-eating [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] evolved, a pest that eventually spread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The planet was taken over by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] under the [[Treaty of Vontor]] in [[25,100 BBY]]. It was later brutally subjugated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which destroyed many of the world's cities.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Vodran in the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]], which is actually located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
